verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a per-role interview plan with stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas that is defined once and reused. The closest items are incidental mentions in other features: AI notes mapped to scorecard questions, an assessment-partner 'interview workflow', and an API that retrieves candidate stage. These are adjacent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
